lines.zh: 我很小，走起来摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: I am small, and my walk is unsteady.

lines.zh: 我一走，脚边的石屑就浮起来。
lines.en: As I walk, chips of stone float up around my feet.

lines.zh: 我拖着一段还没长好的身体。
lines.en: I drag a body that has not finished growing.

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝有热量的方向。
lines.en: I go step by step toward the warmth.

lines.zh: 我身上的结晶还没定型。
lines.en: My crystals have not set their shape.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草会矮下去。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass grows stunted.

lines.zh: 我停下来，试了试新的那条腿。
lines.en: I stop and test the new leg.
My walk is unsteady, but not slow.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，往前挪。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the crack and move on.
My body keeps changing.

lines.zh: 我跟着地面上的纹路走。
lines.en: I follow the lines on the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起手看了看，它又长了。
lines.en: I lift a hand. It has grown again.

lines.zh: 我站着，身体在慢慢拉长。
lines.en: I stand; my body slowly lengthens.

lines.zh: 我身上有一块还没成形。
lines.en: One part of me has no shape yet.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的、断续的响声。
lines.en: I click faintly, in broken beats.
I am reading this ground.
My shadow is much larger than I am.
I have no lungs, and nothing to gasp.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，颈骨还没长全。
lines.en: I raise my head; my neck is not fully grown.
The soil under me has turned grey.
I am waiting to grow a little more.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有轮廓在晃。
lines.en: I hold still; only my outline wavers.
I look up at you. You are tall.

lines.zh: 我在翻看你身上的痕迹。
lines.en: I am reading the marks on you.
I close half a step and stop.
You back away; I stop.
I tilt my head, as if learning from you.
I reach a thin limb out to probe you.
I take your shape into my body.
A little stone grit falls off me.
I do not cry out. I only look.
You glance at me again.
I lost a piece. It is growing back.
I tip over and push back up.
My outline scrambles.
A short burst of static comes from me.
I retreat and shrink to the wall.
My fallen fragments roll away.
A layer of me is shorn off.
I slowly draw myself in.
I stop to focus on mending.
I regrow that leg.
This, I will take apart.

lines.zh: 我伸出一条细长的肢体。
lines.en: I extend a long, thin limb.
I curl around it and draw it in.
It does not dissolve inside me.
I spit it out and look again.
This is not enough for me.
I knead it into the mud. No.

lines.zh: 我身上多了一小块硬的地方。
lines.en: A hard patch forms on me.
I come closer to your hand again.
I stop reaching and draw back.
You bump me; I tip sideways.
I am light; I am pushed two steps.
I catch your hem to steady myself.
My grit rubs onto you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我倒在地上。
lines.en: We collide; I land on the ground.
I get up slowly and keep walking.
I am not angry. I simply do not give way.
I go around you.
I press low and slip by.
I retreat to the wall and steady myself.
Another is still forming.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，边缘粘住。
lines.en: We lean together, edges sticking.
I give it a fragment.

lines.zh: 它接过去，慢慢长进身体。
lines.en: It takes it in and slowly grows it.
Together we grey the soil.

lines.zh: 我们同时发出断续的响。
lines.en: We click at the same moment.
It is more complete than I am.

lines.zh: 我们在暗处靠了一会儿。
lines.en: We lean together in the dark a while.
It moves first; I follow two steps.
We part and each keeps growing.
I curl a thin limb around it.
I hold it before me a long while.
I try to take it in.
Too hard. I cannot take it in.
I put it in a crack.
It greys in my hand.
It is no use to me. Dropped.
I bury it as a marker.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用肢体带。
lines.en: I have no hands. Only limbs to carry it.

lines.zh: 我把它推给旁边的石头。
lines.en: I push it beside a stone.

lines.zh: 我在你身上读到东西了。
lines.en: I have read something in you.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子往你那边去。
lines.en: I drag my body toward you.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶簇忽然闪了。
lines.en: The crystal clusters on me flare.
My edges are no longer blurred.
You stand there. I can see you.
I am not quick. I will arrive slowly.
I stretch my body out a length.

lines.zh: 你的方位刻进我的结晶。
lines.en: Your position is cut into my crystal.
You have no crystal.
The clicking in my throat changes.
I have raised one leg.

lines.zh: 我把这段路一点点吃掉。
lines.en: I eat up the distance bit by bit.
You give half a step; I follow.
I will not stop.
I head for the nearest warmth.
You still have a little distance.
I follow, my steps unsteady.
You turn; I hit the wall.
I get up and keep following.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我掉一块，又长回来。
lines.en: You cut me; I lose a piece and grow it back.
I creep closer, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我背上的结晶一点点烧亮。
lines.en: The crystals on my back burn brighter.
I do not cry out. My voice is soft.

lines.zh: 你听得见我身上的响声。
lines.en: You can hear the clicking.
The wall behind you is greying.
I am growing, larger and larger.
I herd you toward the corner.
Grit keeps rattling under my feet.

lines.zh: 你回头，我已经近了一些。
lines.en: You look back; I am a little nearer.
I wait for your steps to halt.

lines.zh: 我把地上的石屑都吸过来。
lines.en: I draw the grit off the ground.

lines.zh: 我的身体比刚才更硬了。
lines.en: My body is harder than before.
You back out the door; I keep walking.
Each step grows steadier.
You are standing too close to me.

lines.zh: 我的步子忽然紧了起来。
lines.en: My steps suddenly quicken.

lines.zh: 我伸出的肢体抽在你腿上。
lines.en: My limb whips your leg.
I drive a crystal into your skin.

lines.zh: 我把结晶刺进你的脚背。
lines.en: I drive a crystal into the top of your foot.

lines.zh: 我整个人扑上去，很轻但很硬。
lines.en: I throw myself at you, light but hard.

lines.zh: 这一下扑空了，我摔在地上。
lines.en: I miss and land on the ground.
I coil around your wrist.
My fragments spray your face.
I fling my whole body onto you.
You throw me off; I rise again.
I reach out of the crack.

lines.zh: 我把你的一截衣服撕下来。
lines.en: I tear a strip off your clothes.
I pull back and grow a new piece.

lines.zh: 我的响声钻进你耳朵里。
lines.en: My clicking crawls into your ear.
You hit me; I come apart a little.

lines.zh: 散开的碎片又贴回我身上。
lines.en: The scattered pieces cling back to me.
I push you toward the wall.
My edge is sharp.
I catch your shoulder and climb.
My weight is increasing.

lines.zh: 我整个压下去，你撑不住。
lines.en: I bear down; you cannot hold.

lines.zh: 我从土里长出来，还很小。
lines.en: I grow out of the soil. Still small.
I take shape first, then steady.
My first sound comes out broken.
I turn a circle on the spot.
Barely steady, I shuffle twice.
Grit still falls off me.

lines.zh: 这里的东西我都不认识。
lines.en: I know nothing here.
I begin reading the ground.

lines.zh: 我朝有热量的方向动了动。
lines.en: I stir toward the warmth.
I slowly push myself upright.
I wait to be complete.
I look up for the light above.
Fire bakes me; my surface whitens.
I break apart and slowly gather.
Water carries part of me away.
The blast tears me open; fragments scatter.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我还没硬的部位。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the part of me not yet hard.
That light makes my structure unstable.

lines.zh: 没有东西可吸收，我在缩小。
lines.en: Nothing to absorb; I am shrinking.

lines.zh: 雷顺着结晶烧遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs along my crystals.

lines.zh: 黑暗把我从地上拔起来。
lines.en: Darkness pulls me off the ground.
